1.title: What Is Generative Artificial Intelligence?
1.preview: Learn the fundamentals of generative AI and how it's transforming industries...

lessons.title: What is Generative AI?
lessons.description: Understand the fundamentals of generative artificial intelligence and its applications across various fields.
objectives: Define generative AI and its key characteristics.
Identify common applications of generative AI.
Distinguish GenAI from traditional AI.

transcript.text: Welcome to the Generative AI course. Let's dive into this exciting topic.
Generative AI is a field that focuses on creating new content, like text, images, and video.
It's different from traditional AI, which is often used for classification or prediction.

transcript.text: Foundation models are the core of modern generative AI.
These large models are pre-trained on a massive amount of data.
This allows them to perform a wide variety of tasks with minimal fine-tuning.
